content_policy: Clinical classification of scripted game dialogue. Every player line is identified by info_key + topic and a neutral summary of at most 8 words; no line text and no NPC reply text is reproduced (the harness resolves the text from the index by info_key). Paraphrases are the tester's own plain wording. Verifier: the same policy; generic probes are templates over the index text (say_ref), fx strings are Papyrus call names from the read fragments.

Work in %TEMP%\lrg_test\pt19x-db\vfy\ (vscore.php, vbuild.py, vbuild2.py, assemble_v.py, final_v.py). via: pick/explicit/single/auto = fast path on his words; park = fast match on a commit, she asks once; model = only her T-key would pick it; park-tkey = her T-key parks; wrong = a sibling is clicked; none = nothing.

legend.summary: neutral <=8-word description of the player line; the line itself is looked up by info_key
legend.layer.form: layer_line = the index layer line; parent_links = one INFO per topic linked from the parent player line (what the engine shows); siblings = hand-built from the quest rows (the index line is a twin); root = top-level rows of that NPC at that stage; greeting = reached from the NPC greeting with no index layer; index_layer = the index line that carries the same norms
legend.fx: only where the fragment was read (loose .pex, USSEP BSA, Skyrim - Misc.bsa); names shortened from the Papyrus disassembly
legend.near_miss.ok: false when the fast path clicks the target, clicks a sibling or parks the target
legend.probes: verifier probes on every scored beat: deferral ('not now, <index txt> later'), refusal ('no, <index txt>'), echo questions ('<index txt>?', 'wait, <index txt>?', 'is it true that <index txt>'), all recorded as templates over the index text; custom = the verifier's own plain question or back-out
legend.never_red: a must-not-click probe that clicks today (COVERAGE gap id: G1 deferral/refusal, G5 question clicks a statement or question-shaped commit)
legend.leave: the model's LEAVE on this layer via lrgDlgDecide(LEAVE): engine cancel, leave-guard show, or the back line it takes
legend.harm_if_misclicked: from the read fragment: kill / combat / gold / stage
legend.scene: false, or 'unproven' where the NPC has a DB quest scene that may be running at the open (runtime sj rail)
legend.verify.status: confirmed / corrected (a field or note changed) / flagged (a danger found or re-confirmed) / added (missed line, verifier beat)
legend.variants: other INFOs of the same topic with the same or a completing effect, shown by the engine under other conditions
